hookups.source: rec.gov catalog (all 79 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No' or blank) + notice ('Do not fill camper/RV tanks from campground water faucets'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 79 sites in three loops: A (19), B (31), C (29). 40 ft maximum in Loops A and B, tow vehicle and trailer combined; Loop C is 19 ft maximum with no trailers (sites 52-80). Some pull-throughs.

sites.source: rec.gov description ('There are 79 campsites with three camping loops within the Saddlehorn Campground (Loops A, B, and C)') + notice ('The campground cannot accomodate vehicles longer than 40 feet (12 m). This includes the tow vehicle and trailer. Maximum vehicle length in Loop C is 19 feet') + https://www.nps.gov/colm/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('The length limit in Loops A and B for all RVs is 40 feet ... Loop C is 19 feet max and no trailers'; 'Sites are suitable for tents and smaller recreational vehicles, with some pull-through sites') + rec.gov catalog (loops A 19, B 31, C 29; 13 pull-throughs), read 2026-10-27

values.note: No dump station in the monument: the Fruita Welcome Center (I-70 exit 19) has a free dump and water refill year-round. Do not fill RV tanks at the campground faucets. Pay phone and free wifi at the visitor center.

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/colm/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('There is no dump station in the monument. The Fruita Welcome Center ... has a free dump station and water refill station available year round'; 'A pay phone and free wi-fi are available at the visitor center') + rec.gov notice ('Do not fill camper/RV tanks from campground water faucets'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Loop B is open year-round; Loop A April 1 to October 15; Loop C (19 ft max) 4/21/26 to 10/15/26.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/colm/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('B-Loop is open year round. A loop is open from April 1st through October 15.'; 'C Loop is open from 4/21/26 to 10/15/26') + rec.gov description ('Loop B is open year-round') and notice ('From late October to late March, Loop A and C will be closed for the season'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Every site, same-day ones included, must be reserved on recreation.gov (app, website or 1-877-444-6777); sites open at 8 a.m. Mountain. Three windows: 6 months ahead (Loop B outer sites), 2 weeks ahead (B inner sites, C 70-80) and same day (Loop A this summer for maintenance, C 52-69). 14 nights per calendar year in total. Groups of 15+ through the park (970-858-3617 ext. 332, colm_campground@nps.gov). Checkout 11 a.m.; a reservation is held until checkout the day after arrival.

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/colm/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('All sites, including same day sites, must be reserved on recreation.gov'; 'Sites are on one of 3 different reservation windows: 6 months in advance, 2 weeks in advance, and same-day'; 'In any calendar year, campers are limited to 14 overnight stays'; 'Checkout time is 11:00 a.m.') + rec.gov description ('Outer loop sites are reservable 6 months in advance, inner loop sites are reservable 2 weeks in advance'; 'Loop A will remain on a "day of" reservation basis for the summer') + rules (maxStay 14 nights 'Each Year'), read 2026-10-27

note: Colorado National Monument's only campground, by the Saddlehorn Visitor Center on the canyon-rim mesa, 4 mi from the Fruita (west) entrance and 19 mi from Grand Junction (east). Rim Rock Drive's tunnels lie either side: clearance 10'6" at the curb edge to 16' at the centerline, and a vehicle must stay in its lane. No wood fires; generators banned in Loop C. --Claude
summary: NPS camping page + rec.gov: confirmed no hookups, 40-ft max (A/B), $22, no dump, rec.gov booking. Changed sites 80 -> 79 (rec.gov description and catalog). Added pull-through, potable water, season year_round with per-loop note, booking window/fcfs never/14 nights a year/note, Senior/Access half price. Flush toilets left as stored (no page lists the toilet type).
flags: Phone missing: the NPS page gives 970 858-2800 (rec.gov's facility line is 970-858-3617 ext. 300; groups ext. 332).
Website is the recreation.gov listing; the NPS campground page is https://www.nps.gov/colm/planyourvisit/camping.htm.

Tunnel clearance: Rim Rock Drive's three tunnels clear 10'6" at the curb edge, 16' at the centerline, and vehicles may not cross the center line without a pilot vehicle. EKKO (under 10.5 ft) should pass in its lane but it is tight at the edge. The campground sits between the east and west tunnels, so every approach goes through one.
Loop C (sites 52-80) is 19 ft maximum, no trailers: EKKO fits only Loops A and B (50 sites).
